EOS_actions_ack_v1.description: Result envelope for one primitive invocation.

command_id.description: globally unique idempotency and cancellation key; null only for an internal pre-envelope rejection
command_id.title: Command Id

primitive_version.description: Exact version of the primitive that produced this acknowledgement.
primitive_version.title: Primitive Version

reason.description: human-readable admission-rejection detail; null for every admitted command, including terminal failure
reason.title: Reason

reason_code.description: machine-readable admission-rejection taxonomy; null for every admitted command, including terminal failure

result.description: terminal result; status is always present and admitted failure details remain inside this object
result.title: Result

EOS_actions_ack_v1.title: PrimitiveAck

EOS_actions_arm_init_v1.description: Move an arm to the initial joint pose configured for the selected device.
EOS_actions_arm_init_v1.title: ArmInitPrimitive

EOS_actions_arm_movej_v1.description: Release one complete absolute or relative joint-angle target to an arm.

joint_positions_rad.description: All configured joints in device joint_names order, in radians.

speed_rad_s.description: Optional joint speed in radians per second.

stream.description: Return after publishing instead of waiting for terminal completion.

EOS_actions_arm_movel_v1.description: Release one complete absolute or relative Cartesian pose target to an arm.

frame_id.description: Required coordinate frame for an absolute target.

speed_m_s.description: Optional Cartesian speed in metres per second.

stream.description: Return after publishing instead of waiting for terminal completion.

EOS_actions_arm_pick_v1.description: Ask the selected arm backend to pick one object identified by a current world or detection snapshot.

EOS_actions_base_navigate_v1.description: Navigate the base to one absolute or relative planar target.

frame_id.description: Required coordinate frame for an absolute target.

speed.description: Island Base navigation speed: 0 normal, 1 low, 2 high; defaults to 1.

stream.description: Return after releasing instead of waiting for terminal completion.

z_m.description: Optional map height for an absolute target; defaults to the current map height.

EOS_actions_base_posture_v1.description: Release the base body posture (robotic dog: stand / walk / lie).
EOS_actions_base_posture_v1.title: BasePosturePrimitive

EOS_actions_base_velocity_v1.description: Release one body-frame base velocity setpoint with a fail-closed validity lease.

angular_z_rad_s.description: Body-frame yaw velocity in radians per second; EOS advertises the admitted device range through body discovery.

linear_x_m_s.description: Body-frame forward velocity in metres per second; EOS advertises the admitted device range through body discovery.

linear_y_m_s.description: Body-frame lateral velocity in metres per second; EOS advertises the admitted device range through body discovery.

valid_for_ms.description: Fail-closed validity lease in milliseconds; EOS advertises the admitted range through body discovery.

EOS_actions_base_velocity_v1.title: BaseVelocityPrimitive

EOS_actions_face_register_v1.description: Register the face in the camera's latest frame under a human-readable name.

EOS_actions_gimbal_motion_v1.description: Release one absolute or relative pan/tilt target to a gimbal.

speed_rad_s.description: Optional slew speed in radians per second.

stream.description: Return after publishing instead of waiting for terminal completion.

EOS_actions_gripper_motion_v1.description: Release one bounded open or close motion to a gripper.

force_n.description: Optional calibrated grip force in newtons.

opening_pct.description: Optional target opening percentage. Inspire supports only 0 and 100.

EOS_actions_motion_stop_v1.description: Clamp the explicitly targeted motion device.
EOS_actions_motion_stop_v1.title: MotionStopPrimitive

EOS_actions_robot_stop_v1.description: Bring every motion-capable robot part to a controlled stop.
EOS_actions_robot_stop_v1.title: RobotStopPrimitive

EOS_actions_safety_estop_v1.description: Engage the emergency stop immediately; overrides every other primitive.
EOS_actions_safety_estop_v1.title: SafetyEstopPrimitive

EOS_actions_speaker_play_v1.description: Play one EOS-readable audio asset through a speaker.

EOS_actions_speaker_speak_v1.description: Synthesize bounded text and play the resulting audio through a speaker.

EOS_body_base_v1.description: Northbound discovery, configuration, and operational status for a mobile base. EOS publishes map-relative pose and velocity through a world scene resource, not as raw hardware passthrough.
EOS_body_base_v1.title: BaseDevice

EOS_body_camera_v1.description: Northbound discovery, configuration, and operational status for a camera. Raw frames remain inside EOS and derived vision products belong to world resources.
EOS_body_camera_v1.title: CameraDevice

EOS_body_gimbal_v1.description: Northbound discovery, configuration, and operational status for a gimbal. EOS may use measured orientation internally when producing world resources.
EOS_body_gimbal_v1.title: GimbalDevice

EOS_body_gripper_v1.description: Northbound discovery, configuration, and operational status for a gripper. Held-object identity is an EOS perception association, not a gripper hardware claim.
EOS_body_gripper_v1.title: GripperDevice

EOS_body_manipulator_v1.description: Northbound discovery, configuration, and operational status for a manipulator. EOS may use joint and Cartesian hardware state internally when producing world resources.
EOS_body_manipulator_v1.title: ManipulatorDevice

EOS_body_mic_v1.description: Northbound discovery, configuration, and operational status for a microphone. PCM remains inside EOS; normalized VAD and ASR results belong to world resources.
EOS_body_mic_v1.title: MicrophoneDevice

EOS_body_speaker_v1.description: Northbound discovery, configuration, and playback status for a speaker. Generated or queued audio content is not exposed as perception data.
EOS_body_speaker_v1.title: SpeakerDevice

EOS_world_arm_status_v1.description: Normalized manipulator health, joint telemetry, and end-effector pose.
EOS_world_arm_status_v1.title: ArmStatus

EOS_world_asr_v1.description: Compact recognized speech for agent decisions; excludes audio, VAD, and token timing.
EOS_world_asr_v1.title: AsrSnapshot

EOS_world_base_status_v1.description: Normalized mobile-base health, localization, power, and motion status.
EOS_world_base_status_v1.title: BaseStatus

activity.description: Temporary compatibility field: meaningful action, otherwise pose.

name_similarity.description: Similarity score from the face observation that established the retained identity.

name_source_generation.description: Camera generation of the face observation that established the retained identity for this human track.

bbox.description: Detection bounds as left, top, right, and bottom source-image pixels.

keypoint_depth_m.description: Optional aligned metric depth for each COCO-17 joint; null means confidence or depth was insufficient.

keypoints.description: COCO-17 joints in source-image pixel coordinates.

polygon.description: Optional segmentation outline in source-image pixel coordinates.

ModelState.description: Independent progress and source provenance for one asynchronous model stage.

requested_generation.description: Newest generation requested from this stage, or zero when it has never been requested.

source_generation.description: Generation that produced the retained completed value, or zero before first completion.

EOS_world_detection_v1.description: Compact semantic detections with typed human and object identities.

depth_available.description: An aligned depth PNG accompanied the RGB image sent to the pose model.

face_observation.description: Source and age at assembly time of the asynchronous face observation projected by track onto this pose snapshot.

face_recognition_status.description: Compatibility summary of the asynchronous face model state.

models.description: Independent asynchronous state for each model stage.

pose_observation.description: Provenance and assembly-time age of joints and pose attributes retained by track.

source_clock.description: Clock domain for source_timestamp_ns; source times are comparable only within one domain and clock ID.

source_clock_id.description: Producer-defined identity for the source clock within its domain.

source_frame_id.description: Camera optical coordinate frame; not a video frame number.

source_generation.description: Generation of the source camera sample submitted to this detection pipeline.

source_gimbal.description: Gimbal telemetry sampled and retained with this source camera frame.

source_sequence.description: Captured source-frame sequence. Model completion progress is reported independently under models.

source_timestamp_ns.description: Optional source camera stamp in nanoseconds, kept in its original clock domain.

EOS_world_detection_v1.title: DetectionSnapshot

EOS_world_gripper_status_v1.description: Normalized gripper health and measured jaw status.
EOS_world_gripper_status_v1.title: GripperStatus

EOS_world_vad_v1.description: Compact voice activity for one processed microphone window; excludes audio and utterance data.

source_sequence.description: Completed VAD result sequence; advances once for each successful model result.

source_timestamp_ns.description: Optional microphone stamp in nanoseconds, kept in its original clock domain.

EOS_world_vad_v1.title: VadSnapshot

EOS_world_vision_v1.description: One or two recent raw RGB camera pictures encoded as JPEG, never a video stream.
EOS_world_vision_v1.title: VisionSnapshot

EOS_world_world_v1.description: Fused external physical entities and relations, excluding robot body state.
EOS_world_world_v1.title: WorldSnapshot
